options.content: Free provider capacity · % left and reset per provider. Short windows are blue above zero. Only weekly/monthly windows are paced.

panels.description: The capacity of every account, one card per account and one row per capacity window of the account, and the free models the provider holds apart from its paid allowance. The share that is left, the line of the even spend, the reset and the age of the reading are the collector's account window gauges, and the pace reads the difference between the two. An account that publishes no window of its own is learning, and says so in one line under the cards.

targets.expr:
max by (account, kind, quota_id, label, evidence, provider, state, basis, reason, field) (
          label_replace(ghostship_ai_account_window_remaining_ratio{account=~"${capacity_account:regex}"} and (timestamp(ghostship_ai_account_window_remaining_ratio{account=~"${capacity_account:regex}"}) > scalar(max(timestamp(ghostship_ai_collection_duration_seconds))) - 90), "field", "left", "", "")
          or label_replace(ghostship_ai_account_window_expected_remaining_ratio{account=~"${capacity_account:regex}"} and (timestamp(ghostship_ai_account_window_expected_remaining_ratio{account=~"${capacity_account:regex}"}) > scalar(max(timestamp(ghostship_ai_collection_duration_seconds))) - 90), "field", "expected", "", "")
          or label_replace(ghostship_ai_account_window_reset_timestamp_seconds{account=~"${capacity_account:regex}"} and (timestamp(ghostship_ai_account_window_reset_timestamp_seconds{account=~"${capacity_account:regex}"}) > scalar(max(timestamp(ghostship_ai_collection_duration_seconds))) - 90), "field", "resetAt", "", "")
          or label_replace(ghostship_ai_account_window_check_timestamp_seconds{account=~"${capacity_account:regex}"} and (timestamp(ghostship_ai_account_window_check_timestamp_seconds{account=~"${capacity_account:regex}"}) > scalar(max(timestamp(ghostship_ai_collection_duration_seconds))) - 90), "field", "checked", "", "")
          or label_replace(ghostship_ai_account_window_rolling{account=~"${capacity_account:regex}"} and (timestamp(ghostship_ai_account_window_rolling{account=~"${capacity_account:regex}"}) > scalar(max(timestamp(ghostship_ai_collection_duration_seconds))) - 90), "field", "rolling", "", "")
          or label_replace(ghostship_ai_account_window_order{account=~"${capacity_account:regex}"} and (timestamp(ghostship_ai_account_window_order{account=~"${capacity_account:regex}"}) > scalar(max(timestamp(ghostship_ai_collection_duration_seconds))) - 90), "field", "order", "", "")
          or label_replace(ghostship_ai_account_window_learning{account=~"${capacity_account:regex}"} and (timestamp(ghostship_ai_account_window_learning{account=~"${capacity_account:regex}"}) > scalar(max(timestamp(ghostship_ai_collection_duration_seconds))) - 90), "field", "learning", "", "")
          or label_replace(ghostship_ai_provider_free_models{provider=~"${capacity_account:regex}",} and (timestamp(ghostship_ai_provider_free_models{provider=~"${capacity_account:regex}",}) > scalar(max(timestamp(ghostship_ai_collection_duration_seconds))) - 90), "field", "free_models", "", "")
         or label_replace(ghostship_ai_account_window_pace_state{account=~"${capacity_account:regex}"} and (timestamp(ghostship_ai_account_window_pace_state{account=~"${capacity_account:regex}"}) > scalar(max(timestamp(ghostship_ai_collection_duration_seconds))) - 90), "field", "pace_state", "", "") or label_replace(ghostship_ai_account_availability{account=~"${capacity_account:regex}"} and (timestamp(ghostship_ai_account_availability{account=~"${capacity_account:regex}"}) > scalar(max(timestamp(ghostship_ai_collection_duration_seconds))) - 90), "field", "availability", "", "") or label_replace(ghostship_ai_account_availability_check_timestamp_seconds{account=~"${capacity_account:regex}"} and (timestamp(ghostship_ai_account_availability_check_timestamp_seconds{account=~"${capacity_account:regex}"}) > scalar(max(timestamp(ghostship_ai_collection_duration_seconds))) - 90), "field", "availability_checked", "", "")
)
 or label_replace(ghostship_ai_account_window_pace_delta_points{account=~"${capacity_account:regex}"} and (timestamp(ghostship_ai_account_window_pace_delta_points{account=~"${capacity_account:regex}"}) > scalar(max(timestamp(ghostship_ai_collection_duration_seconds))) - 90), "field", "pace_delta", "", "")
